text.en: Pet owners express deep appreciation for the veterinary surgeons and support staff at Clifton Road, commending their warmth, kindness, and professional competence. Reviewers highlight that clinicians consistently treat owners with respect, keep them at ease during consultations, and provide attentive veterinary medical attention.

title.en: Thoughtful treatment for dogs and cats

text.en: Clients note that animals receive gentle, reassuring care during physical checkups and routine clinical examinations. Reviewers mention that both dogs and cats appear relaxed around the practitioners, with owners feeling confident that their pets are looked after with genuine patience and sensitivity.

Experiences with appointment timing and triage differ across recent visits. While some clients report prompt scheduling and immediate attention for urgent issues like grass seed removals, another reviewer reported severe frustration with reception staff failing to prioritise an urgent feline medical emergency.

q.en: Can urgent procedures be performed quickly at the clinic?

a.en: Yes, clients report fast and effective attention for urgent problems, such as foreign body and grass seed removals.

q.en: Does the Clifton Road surgery treat cats and dogs?

a.en: Yes, the practice routinely treats both feline and canine companions for preventive health, diagnostics, and surgery.

q.en: What facilities are available at Paxton Vets Clifton Road?

a.en: The practice offers consulting rooms, digital radiography, an operating theatre, in-house diagnostics, and dedicated recovery wards.

q.en: Are appointments seen on time at the surgery?

a.en: Reviewers generally note prompt appointment times, though some clients advise calling the veterinary team directly in acute emergencies.
